name: ga4gh-passport skill
summary: Validate GA4GH Passport visas (encoded JWT strings) against a configured GA4GH Passport clearinghouse and report per-passport authorization
description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH Passport, shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-passport` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Validate GA4GH Passport visas (encoded JWT strings) against a configured GA4GH Passport clearinghouse and report per-passport authorization. Use when the user asks to check researcher authorization, validate a GA4GH Passport or visa, or verify access under the GA4GH Passport / AAI (Authentication and Authorization Infrastructure) standard.
